messages.subject: font change in saved plot
parts:
Hello,

I noticed that font displayed is not the font saved when the plot is
saved with ggsave. Here is my syntax. I tried using different fonts
with same result, so the ggsave is definitely not using the font I
prescribe when saving the plot.

---------------------------------------------------
# Invoke qplot
qplot(Eigen1, Eigen2, label=colnames(gdistmat), geom=c("text"),
xlab="PCo1", ylab="PCo2", main="Nei (1983)
Genetic Distance", xlim=c(-0.22, 0.41), color=c(Eigen1, Eigen2))

# Change fonts
grid.gedit("GRID.text",gp=gpar(fontfamily="gill sans", fontsize="10"))

# Save the plot
filename="nei83.png"
ggsave(filename, scale=1.5)
--------------------------------------------------

Thanks
Vikram

messages.author: affa918ed63b6275
messages.subject: Re: font change in saved plot
parts:
Hi,

ggsave saves ggGrob object, not graphic device.
if you modify something outside ggplot2 and want to save it,
then you need use dev.copy, pdf, png, etc, depending on the device.

In your case, simply,

png(filename)

--
